basis: Controlling uploaded Entry EXIT Capital handoff and committed integration plan R11

entryHandling.fillPrice: Exact saved final price = exact raw1m entry-minute OPEN * 1.0005; no second Entry slippage
entryHandling.cost: Frozen Candidate A and Fixed12 subtract 0.05 percentage points once, from returns rebased to the unchanged effective Entry price. The saved Entry price already includes 5bps buy slippage; do not describe total friction as all-in 5bps.
entryHandling.labelsQualityAndOtherFutureFields: Never copied into six-field Entry envelope; no Entry decision module invoked

geometry.offGridRule: Actual Entry time and price never rounded. Only complete calendar-anchored regular5m buckets wholly after Entry are consumed; the containing partial bucket is excluded. First bucket starts at ceil(entryMinute/5)*5, skipping lunch.
geometry.example: 09:31 Entry stays 09:31; first eligible completed regular5m bar is 09:35-09:40. Fixed12 counts these full post-entry regular bars.
geometry.preEntryHigh: Never included in PROTECT arm; initial partial bucket is not substituted by an Entry-anchored synthetic 5m bar
geometry.calendar: Inherited projectPath: end minute 900 before 2024-11-05, 930 thereafter; regular starts 540-689 and 750-(end-1); 690/930 auction rows excluded
geometry.terminalMissing: Do not shorten inherited 15:30 cap to 15:25, insert an auction print or forward-fill a missing 15:25-15:30 bucket. Censor explicitly.
geometry.aggregation: Use saved current-cohort raw1m only. Nonempty regular buckets use first observed Open/max High/min Low/last observed Close and retain observedMinutes; empty buckets missing. No interpolation or new provider.
geometry.openTimestamp: First actual observed source minute of the next regular5m bucket; never backdate cash release to nominal bucket start when sparse
geometry.old3800PathCache: Not joined: no matching current2155 identity lineage; use same aggregation/calendar semantics on saved current raw archive instead

exit.candidate: Call unchanged phase57_new_long_exit_candidate_a.policy, not old hardwired build
exit.arm: First completed HIGH >= 3%; a later completed CLOSE <= 1% signals
exit.protectReference: Next regular5m first-observed OPEN strictly after signal completion or at its boundary
exit.fallback: Exact Fixed12 CLOSE at min(12, remaining eligible regular slots)
exit.missing: Evaluate all fills. A later unresolved Fixed12 must not suppress an earlier causal PROTECT exit. If Candidate cannot exit before missing data, keep unresolved and capital locked.
exit.futureAvailabilityFilter: Forbidden in Entry and Capital; paired evaluator subset is explicitly separate from full ledger

evaluation.primary: Within each Entry, Candidate A vs Fixed12 on identical resolved IDs; report no-entry, censored and Candidate-only-resolved counts separately
evaluation.crossEntry: Report both each-policy common-resolved and four-cell common-resolved comparisons; never compare different denominators as paired
evaluation.preservation: Keep old exitBar>=firstHitBar statistic as legacySlotPreserved; also report ownershipTimeCredited excluding an EXIT-bar HIGH reached after exiting at that bar OPEN. Do not relabel the old statistic or change policy to improve it.
evaluation.capital: Not run in R13. Full ledger includes unresolved positions and rejects outcome filtering; no final Entry winner chosen here.
